scope: 96 fresh 64 MiB old-space Node/V8 processes (six alternating trials, four native clients, empty/populated cache). Each dispatches 72 compiled entry VMs in one JS turn before a microtask drain, mixing nine supported Spotify startup routes with 12/40/90 KiB self-written bodies. Original input ownership is released at done; the harness records pending invocations/input bytes and actual heap/RSS samples without forcing GC during a burst. This models a deliberately same-turn scheduler, not a captured Loon/iOS scheduling policy or total VPN memory. All output body hashes must match.
